vlc.finding: The immediate failure comes from an incomplete local decoded-frame reference, not different network frames. The scheduling/decoder trigger is not established.
vlc.local_reproduction: Pinned VLC and FFmpeg on Linux ARM: 20 ordinary plus 20 CPU-contention decodes, no invalid-picture event; architecture differs from hosted x86-64. An additional 20 decodes with distribution FFmpeg also passed.

filecc.finding: The explicit NAK precondition was not established. Flight-wide RTO can select newly sent packets before later DATA exposes their loss. No causal sender-timer trace was retained in the hosted failure; its exact timing trigger is unresolved.
filecc.local_reproduction: 15 Linux ARM repetitions passed across initiator/responder roles; no claim that this fixes the hosted failure.
